$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKE (AIP France, chart dated 2025-12-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Saint-Jean-en-Royans

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 141, for landing due to environment
notes: AD reserved for ACFT and gliders and for pilots complying with one of the following conditions: to have been tested in flight able to use the AD by a pilot instructor (or hold a flight instructor qualification).; to be a mountain licenced pilot.
Presence of obstacles: RWY 14 landing funnel and RWY 32 take-off funnel as well as in front of ACB Preferred QFU 141° for landing due to environment.
No parking outside the areas designated in ATT 01.
TKOF RWY 32 mandatory: TKOF and Touch and Go prohibited RWY 14 due to relief nearby.
Maintain the TKOF axis go to the river "La Lyonne", then heading alteration to the right strictly avoiding overflight of the castle.
Non home-based ACFT can not do more than three training patterns a day.
Paragliders landing on AD at QFU 321°, South of the wind indicator.
Prohibition of inflation of sails on AD and on paragliding landing area.

Aérodrome réservé aux avions et planeurs dont les pilotes répondent à l'une des conditions suivantes : avoir été reconnu apte à utiliser l'aérodrome par un instructeur (ou détenir une qualification d'instructeur). détenir la qualification de vol en montagne.

Présence d'obstacles : trouée d'atterrissage RWY 14 et trouée décollage RWY 32 ainsi qu'en face des hangars ACB (champs de noyers). Par vent secteur Nord, intense activité parapentes sur relief au Sud de l'AD. QFU préférentiel 141° à l'atterrissage cause environnement.
Pas de stationnement en dehors des zones désignées en ATT 01.
TKOF RWY 32 obligatoire : décollage et Touch and Go interdits en RWY 14 cause proximité relief.
Tours de piste limités à 3 par jour pour les aéronefs non basés.
Atterrissage parapentes sur AD au QFU 321°, au Sud de l'indicateur de vent.
Interdiction gonflage de voiles sur AD et sur zone atterrissage parapentes.
